## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
Sector Rotation, not Risk-Off. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +2.57%) ABOVE TREND confirm a risk-on tilt while HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND supports easing credit signals.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Credit signal improving: HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND while LQD (1W: +0.20% | 1M: -0.16%) RECOVERY flags watch for credit divergence; reflation bid: CPER (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +9.65%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-loose: UUP (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -1.48%) BELOW TREND and TLT (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.04%) BELOW TREND point to weaker dollar and higher real yields pressure; Yield curve in RECOVERY suggests modest steepening.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals and commodity-linked sectors leading: Materials (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND and Financials (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND; Tech showing strength as well: XLK (1W: +3.68% | 1M: +4.65%) ABOVE TREND. Defensives weak: Utilities (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND and Consumer Discretionary in CORRECTION (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +4.84%).

5. US vs Global?
US leadership intact: SPY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +2.57%) ABOVE TREND while EEM (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND shows EM catch-up; China FXI (1W: +1.88% | 1M: -0.62%) RECOVERY—watch that regional recovery divergence.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative flows present but cooling: IWM (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +2.91%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +3.10%) ABOVE TREND; Speculation Index falling and IBIT (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +0.10%) ABOVE TREND signals selective crypto/ETF interest.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals and base metals strong: PPLT (1W: +25.55% | 1M: +55.74%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +19.89% | 1M: +52.39%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND. Gold GLD (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +9.65%) ABOVE TREND — reflation + safe-haven mix.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy mixed: XLE (1W: +1.01% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND but broader Energy vs Market below trend; Natural gas UNG (1W: +6.48% | 1M: -7.38%) RECOVERY — volatile, monitor seasonal squeeze.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Equities breadth and core growth ETFs SPY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +2.57%) ABOVE TREND, QQQ (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +2.60%) ABOVE TREND, XLK (1W: +3.68% | 1M: +4.65%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: Bonds TLT (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.04%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: +0.20% | 1M: -0.16%) RECOVERY — monitor credit vs rates.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals/materials exposure given CPER (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND and Materials strength; reduce exposure to Utilities (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND and watch consumer staples. Bonds neutral-to-watch given TLT BELOW TREND and HYG/LQD mixed signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND, Technology XLK (1W: +3.68% | 1M: +4.65%) ABOVE TREND, Industrials (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +4.43%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Utilities (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND, Consumer Staples (1W: -0.23% | 1M: +0.93%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +19.89% | 1M: +52.39%) ABOVE TREND, Copper/CPER (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND and Gold GLD (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +9.65%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NatGas UNG (1W: +6.48% | 1M: -7.38%) RECOVERY remains vulnerable to mean reversion.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health watch), SPY/TLT ratio rising (current SPY vs TLT: SPY/TLT 1W: +1.21% | 1M: +4.45%) ABOVE TREND, CPER strength (breaks above recent highs) as reflation signal.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, VXX falling and SPY ABOVE TREND confirm rotation rather than blanket risk-off. Materials, Financials and Tech showing relative strength (Materials 1W: +3.44% | 1M: +8.35% ABOVE TREND; XLK 1W: +3.68% | 1M: +4.65% ABOVE TREND). Key risk is bond/credit divergence—TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.04%) and LQD RECOVERY (1W: +0.20% | 1M: -0.16%) — monitor credit spreads and LQD/HYG dynamics.
